react.description: An action or selectable choice within a Menu.

tags.devx:
- Use `selectionType`, `selected`, and `onSelectedChange` for controlled selection.
- Use `defaultSelected` when the item owns its initial selection state.
tags.a11y:
- Resolves to `menuitem`, `menuitemradio`, `menuitemcheckbox`, or `option` from the parent Menu purpose.
- Disabled links are removed from navigation and expose `aria-disabled`.
tags.limitations: - Nested submenus require a separate popup composition.

leadingIcon.name: leadingIcon
leadingIcon.description: Optional icon displayed before the label.

trailingIcon.name: trailingIcon
trailingIcon.description: Optional icon displayed after the label.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.

children.name: children
children.description: Custom visible label content; falls back to `label`.

disabled.name: disabled
disabled.description: Prevents activation, selection changes, and keyboard focus.

value.name: value
value.description: Stable application value emitted or consumed by a parent selection surface.

label.name: label
label.description: Text label used when an adapter does not project custom content.

variant.name: variant
variant.description: Overrides the color treatment inherited from the parent Menu.

selectionType.name: selectionType
selectionType.description: Declares whether the item is an action, radio-like choice, or checkbox-like choice.

onSelectedChange.name: onSelectedChange
onSelectedChange.description: Notifies each accepted selection transition exactly once.

href.name: href
href.description: Optional navigation target; disabled links omit the native href.

angular.description: An action or selectable choice within a Menu.

tags.devx: Use `selectionType`, `selected`, and `selectedChange` for controlled selection, or initialize with `defaultSelected`.
tags.a11y: Resolves to `menuitem`, `menuitemradio`, `menuitemcheckbox`, or `option`; disabled links are inert and removed from navigation.
tags.limitations: Nested submenus require a separate popup composition. Angular uses the required `label` input instead of projected item content.
